Qwen Runtime Setup Guide
1. Run a reachable Qwen endpoint. The default local URL is http://localhost:8880/v1.
2. If you open Laboon from GitHub Pages, your local runtime must allow browser CORS. Without CORS, the browser will fail before the request reaches Qwen.
3. Preset Voice mode uses a speaker catalog. You can keep the built-in voices or paste your own JSON catalog in AI Config.
4. Voice Design mode uses a natural-language voice prompt. For hosted Alibaba-style voice design flows, a separate create-voice step may still be required by your runtime.

    Pronunciation Helper

    Look up English CMU phonemes and insert as [PHONEMES] at the cursor — OmniVoice reads brackets as pronunciation override. Useful for medical loanwords mid-Thai narration.

    CMU Phonemes
    Will insert as
    💡 What is CMU markup? & manual entry
    OmniVoice (k2-fsa) reads [PHONEMES] brackets as CMU ARPAbet override for English words. Example: [B EY1 S] = "bass" (low), [B AE1 S] = "bass" (fish). Useful when default pronunciation guesses wrong.

    Mandarin pinyin uses lowercase + tone digits in parentheses, e.g. 重(zhong4). Type that directly in the textarea — no helper needed.

    Not in Datamuse? Look up at the CMU Pronouncing Dictionary online and paste the phonemes (without leading word) in brackets manually.
